architectural-decision-records.why: records the arch-gate travel decision and the optional-config-with-safe-default choice
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0063: arch-gate config optional (default {} = built-ins on); skip vendored machinery (scripts/ci + .githooks via --ignore) and test dirs via DEFAULT_IGNORE; the test-dir default behavior change named
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

pattern-selector.why: applied the chosen tier-2 config model deliberately, naming the rejected alternative
pattern-selector.what: used optional-config-with-safe-default (missing config -> {} built-ins on, config-less consumer still enforced) over scaffold-and-fail-closed (red until filled); recorded the choice and its guarantee in the ADR
quotes: A pattern removes one specific kind of failure or rot

judge-arch.why: made judge-arch own mechanical gate travel, and reviewed the change in fresh context
judge-arch.what: arch-gate.mjs now travels: optional config, --ignore for the vendored machinery, test-dir skip; ran a fresh-context judge-arch review and recorded it in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion

arch-encode.why: a caught false-positive class was turned into an enforced scope rule + meta-test coverage
arch-encode.what: arch-gate false-positived on the vendored gate infra, the .githooks helper, and copied test fixtures; encoded the rule as --ignore scripts/ci/.githooks + test dirs in DEFAULT_IGNORE, and added arch-gate.test.mjs to the CONSUMER-TESTS meta-test so a regression is caught
quotes: A rule you can check mechanically is the goal

verifiable-quality-gates.why: every new behavior has a discriminating test proven to detect
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added discrimination tests: optional-config default still fires the empty-catch built-in and still passes clean/empty trees; --ignore skips the infra, still flags product code, and is cwd-anchored (decoy src/scripts/ci still scanned); extended CONSUMER-TESTS to run arch-gate.test.mjs in a consumer
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: tested at unit level and end-to-end through genesis into a consumer
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: unit tests exercise optional-config and --ignore logic; the genesis path bootstraps a consumer, runs the aggregator over all nine gates clean, then confirms an empty catch in product code turns arch-gate red
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the gate-script change; the travel behaviors are pinned as executable scenarios
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: the behaviors (config-less consumer enforced, clean/empty tree green, infra+test dirs skipped, product violation red, decoy path still scanned) are written as discriminating tests at the lowest layer that proves them
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

skeptical-audit.why: each claim carries an evidence state and re-runnable source, disconfirming case first
skeptical-audit.what: proved travel end-to-end in a genesised consumer (9 gates green clean; arch-gate red on a planted empty catch) and found+fixed two real false-positive sources (scripts/ci self-scan, .githooks helper) before claiming done
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system/data architecture or service change; a CLI gate flag + manifest entry

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no auth/input/crypto/session code; arch-gate scans for structural patterns, this change is its scope/config

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy/migration/feature flag; manifest version already leads at unreleased 1.2.0

sre-operational-readiness.why: no runtime service, SLI/SLO, or alerting surface

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing UI; a gate script and tests only
